title: Senior AI Solutions Sales Executive
location: Canada - Remote (ON, AB, BC, or NS Only)
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry
 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
 Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
 Instacart is a Flex First team
 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
 Why this role is on the menu
 Instacart is building agentic AI solutions directly with and for grocery retailers — and the commercial infrastructure to sell them is being built in real time. We're hiring a Senior Retail Solutions Sales Executive to own that commercial motion end-to-end. This role sits at the intersection of enterprise sales and frontier AI, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to how Instacart becomes the leading AI partner in grocery.
 What you'll cook up in your first year
 A commercial playbook is established and proven — including pricing frameworks, SOW templates, milestone- and outcome-based models, and multi-year partnership structures that become the standard for all AI engagements going forward.

title: Senior Social Manager, Instagram
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
 The Community You Will Join
 At Airbnb, Instagram is where our brand shows up most visibly. It’s where travel, culture, and belonging come to life - not as a point of sale, but as something people choose to spend time with. This role will help define that presence, shaping a feed that feels considered, culturally fluent, and distinctly Airbnb.
 We’re looking for someone who can combine creative instinct, editorial judgment, and platform expertise to build something innovative and enduring. Someone excited by setting the tone, raising the bar, and defining what great looks like - while still moving at the speed of culture.
 The Difference You Will Make
 We’re looking for someone who understands Instagram at a deep, almost instinctive level - not just how it works, but how to win at it.
 You probably spend more time on the platform than anyone you know. You see patterns before they become trends, understand the signals behind the algorithm, and have a clear point of view on what makes content travel - and what makes it feel stale.
 More than anything, you think like an editor. You have a vision and can articulate taste. You know what’s worth saying, how to say it, and when. You understand pacing, sequencing, and how individual posts ladder up into a broader narrative.
 You’ve likely played a meaningful role in shaping and growing an account, with a strong perspective on format, visual language, and storytelling. You understand the nuances of Reels, Carousels, Stories - and how each can be used to build a cohesive, evolving point of view for Airbnb

title: Global Supply Manager
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
 Lyft is seeking an experienced Indirect Global Supply Manager to join our Global Supply Chain Team. In this role, you will oversee indirect spend categories supporting our Safety and Customer Care, People, and Contingent Workforce portfolios, including the technology spend underlying each. You will develop and execute comprehensive sourcing strategies, manage strategic supplier relationships, negotiate complex contracts, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business growth, while delivering measurable cost savings and operational excellence.
 Responsibilities:
 Develop and execute long term Category Strategies for managed categories to achieve cost optimization, drive efficiencies, improve supplier health, and ensure continuous supply
 Drive continuous improvement initiatives and strategy, leveraging technology and data analytics to enhance sourcing effectiveness
 Lead the end-to-end procurement process, including market analysis, RFx development, supplier evaluation, and contract negotiation
 Perform pricing and cost analysis using Excel (pivot tables, lookups, modeling) to build cost models support supplier evaluation and category strategy decisions and quantify savings opportunities
 Implement supplier relationship management (SRM) programs and KPIs to drive optimal performance
 Collaborate with internal cross-functional stakeholders to understand their needs and ensure alignment with business objectives and budgets
 Serve as an advisor and partner to the business to provide subject matter expertise, guidance, and drive best practices and processes
 Strong negotiation skills and experience managing complex contracts
 Knowledge and understanding of contracts to collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and Security teams
